failure.title: Settings could not be loaded
failure.description: Saved data is incompatible with the current format. Retry or reset this section.

reset.confirmation: Reset saved settings in this section? This cannot be undone.

analytics.title: Usage analytics
analytics.description: Disabled by default. When enabled, Knovum sends at most one app-start event per UTC day. You can change this at any time.
analytics.privacy: The event contains only a random installation ID, app version, operating-system platform, and event name. It never includes your Spaces, files, notes, searches, or AI content.
analytics.notConfigured: Usage analytics is not configured in this build, so no events have been sent.
analytics.unavailable: Usage analytics is temporarily unavailable. Knovum continues to work normally.
